home.faqSubtitle: Everything you need to know about CropDoctor AI.
home.faq1Q: Which crops does CropDoctor AI support?
home.faq1A: We support 14 crops: Banana, Barley, Cassava, Coffee, Maize, Mango, Onion, Pepper, Potato, Rice, Sorghum, Soybean, Tomato, and Wheat.
home.faq2Q: Do I need to create an account to use it?
home.faq2A: A free account is required to run scans and save your history. Registration only takes 30 seconds — just email and password.
home.faq3Q: How accurate is the AI disease detection?
home.faq3A: Our AI achieves ~95% accuracy on supported crops. For best results, use a clear, well-lit photo of only the affected leaf.
home.faq4Q: What if my crop is not in the list?
home.faq4A: Upload the photo anyway — our AI will attempt to identify the plant and disease. We are continuously adding new crops.
home.faq5Q: Is CropDoctor AI free to use?
home.faq5A: Yes! CropDoctor AI is completely free for individual farmers. Advanced analytics for agribusinesses are coming soon.

about.heroDesc: CropDoctor AI was built to democratize agricultural expertise — giving every farmer, no matter how remote, access to instant, accurate disease diagnosis and treatment guidance.
about.problemDesc1: In sub-Saharan Africa alone, crop diseases destroy up to 40% of harvests every year. Most smallholder farmers lack access to agronomists or diagnostic labs — by the time they identify a disease, it has already spread.
about.problemDesc2: CropDoctor AI bridges this gap by putting expert-level diagnostics directly in a farmer's pocket — requiring nothing more than a smartphone and a clear photo of the affected leaf.
about.visionDesc: A world where no farmer loses their harvest to a disease that could have been identified and treated in time.
about.whySubtitle: Everything you need to protect your crops, in one place.
about.feat1Desc: Upload a photo and receive a detailed diagnosis within seconds using GPT-4 Vision technology.
about.feat2Desc: Get both organic and chemical treatment options with specific dosages and application methods.
about.feat3Desc: Works in any browser on any device — no app download required, with offline-capable features.
about.feat4Desc: Capture leaf photos directly from your phone camera without leaving the app.
about.feat5Desc: Trained on agronomic data covering the most critical crop diseases affecting African smallholders.
about.feat6Desc: Built with simplicity in mind — easy for farmers with no technical background to use immediately.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.s1Text: We collect information you provide directly to us, such as when you create an account, update your profile, or submit photos for disease detection. This includes your name, email address, phone number, and the crop images you upload.
privacy.s2Text: We use the information we collect to:
privacy.s2Li1: Provide, maintain, and improve our services.
privacy.s2Li2: Process and analyze crop images using our AI models.
privacy.s2Li3: Communicate with you about updates, security alerts, and support messages.
privacy.s3Text: We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your personal information against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction.
privacy.s4Text: Photos uploaded for disease detection may be stored and used to further train and improve our AI models. No personally identifiable information is attached to these images when used for training purposes.
privacy.contactText: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at
